description: Irregularities and unverified items. These do not block the merge. Review each item and tell us what to change.

items.issue: Bib Gourmand conflict. Las Vegas Magazine lists many restaurants as Bib Gourmand (for example Anima by Edo, Bouchon, COTE, Estiatorio Milos, Gymkhana). CVA (S01), Wikipedia (S02) and Travel Weekly (S03) list only 3 Bib Gourmands: China Poblano, Esther's Kitchen and YEN Viet Kitchen. We used S01 and flagged the conflict.

Official Michelin Guide page could not be accessed from this sandbox (guide.michelin.com returned an error). Stars and categories rely on CVA (S01), a government-backed tourism site, and on press coverage (S22, S23, S24). Michelin's own page is the primary source.
Lamaii's site links a Michelin entry at https://guide.michelin.com/is/en/nevada/las-vegas_2935077/restaurant/lamaii. Not accessed. Lamaii's site says 'Selected'. CVA says 'Recommended'.
L'Atelier de Joël Robuchon official hours: open Monday, closed Tuesday and Wednesday, open Thursday-Sunday. This pattern differs from its sister restaurant (Tue-Sat).
Mott 32 location conflict: CVA/Michelin list says 'at The Palazzo', but the linked page is on the Venetian dining site.
Restaurant Guy Savoy: official page did not show full weekly hours (only 'Opens 5:00 PM').
items.action: Check the OpenTable page for hours

items.issue: Sparrow + Wolf official site contains 2025 event content (Valentine's 2025 menu, NYE 2024). Hours and current menu unverified.
Kabuto: the 'daily 5:30-9:00 PM' line appears in an Instagram post caption on the official site, not a hours page. Posts also note possible closures on dates without a schedule.
Wing Lei: Eater's intro wording is ambiguous and mentions 'one star' in a 2008-09 context. The 2026 status is Recommended (S01, S22).
SoulBelly BBQ: official site does not list Monday hours. Monday open status unverified.
Restaurant prices: official pages give only price levels ($ to $$$$), not per-person totals for two. Per-person totals are left blank.
Social-media links: only two verified links found on official sites (SoulBelly Instagram account; Kabuto Instagram post). All others blank.
items.action: Search official site footers for each handle

items.issue: All hotel nightly and 7-night totals are unverified. No official rate for Feb 15-22 2027 was accessible from this sandbox. Left blank.
Queen or larger bed and private bathroom are unverified for every hotel. Left blank.
Hotel addresses are blank for 6 of 8 hotels. Only MGM Grand and The Cosmopolitan addresses came from official pages.
Las Vegas has no subway is supported only by secondary sources (S26). RTC official homepage was fetched; RTC route pages were not. Deuce 24-hour and SDX 9 a.m.-midnight hours are secondary (S25).
No travel times were verified, so the '1 hour by subway or bus' test cannot be applied yet. The ranking uses Michelin counts on each property instead.
items.action: Run RTC trip planner for each pair

Red Rock entry fee amount not captured (BLM fee page not fetched). Timed-entry reservation is required Oct 1 - May 31.
Valley of Fire drive time from the Strip not stated by the official source. Blank.

The preferred 3-night window (Feb 15-18) conflicts with the 7-night costing requirement. Both options are shown.
Feb 15 2027 is a Monday. Joël Robuchon and é are closed that day. SoulBelly's Monday status is unverified.
